name: AOS Conservation Grants
summary: Annual grants for non-commercial, hands-on projects that study, protect or restore orchids and their natural habitats anywhere in the world. International grants need an institution to administer the funds.
reporting: Multiyear projects report annually, and an article, webinar or video on the project goes to the AOS within six months of completion.
